name: StelProbe V Droid
description: The StelProbe V Droid was an exploration/contact droid. The unit had a wide range of sensors, immense capacity to store and analyze data, and advanced weapons systems. Its multiple clawed appendages made it resemble a 4-meter-tall crustacean. The StelProbe V's programming included defensive subroutines that made it respond with force against any being that came within 5 meters. Nevertheless, the droid avoided conflict whenever possible, fleeing rather than fighting if possible. StelProbe V units could move at 100 km/hour.

data.name: StelProbe V Droid
equipment: Immense data storage and processing capacity
